issues.title: Missing GWT Acceptance Criteria for Core Logic
issues.why: While the spec references AC-13, AC-73, etc., the actual '97-acceptance-criteria.md' file is not provided in the context, and the provided files lack explicit GWT (Given-When-Then) clauses for the complex state transitions (PreviousHasError logic).
issues.fix: Append a 'Verifies' section to each endpoint in §04 with explicit GWT scenarios for state transitions.

issues.title: Truncated Examples and Seed Data
issues.why: The context cuts off at 90KB, losing the '14-endpoint-examples.md', '16-seed-data.md', and '18-schema.sql' files which are critical for a 'no-questions' implementation of the DB and API.
issues.fix: Ensure the DDL in §02 is exhaustive or provide the full 18-schema.sql content within the module context.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'Retrieval' URL Construction
issues.why: The Standard Ack Envelope shows relative paths like '/wp-json/git-logs/v2/get-logs' but doesn't specify if these should include the query parameters (RepoUrl, Branch) required to actually use those links.
issues.fix: Explicitly state that Retrieval URLs must be fully qualified and pre-populated with the request's context parameters.
